# GitHub Sync and Terminal Event Evidence Checklist: SPEC-005 ready_for_owner State and Two-Step Terminal Event

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK002 Are merged PR evidence requirements complete for both live GitHub pull responses and deterministic fixture-supplied evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-013, Contract §Merge Evidence Rule]
- [ ] CHK003 Are closed-issue-without-merged-PR reconciliation requirements complete for preserving `ready_for_owner`, avoiding chain advancement, writing reconciliation activity, and notifying the responsible operator? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK004 Are status-label requirements complete for provisioning, inverse status mapping, application, replacement of prior `mc:*` status labels, and idempotency? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Contract §Operator Surfaces]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is it clear that closed PRs, closed issues, branch metadata, and PR metadata that do not resolve to the exact linked repo/PR are insufficient terminal evidence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the `pullFromGitHub(project, workspaceId, opts?)` seam unambiguous about production callsites passing no fixture/options while tests may pass `{ webhookFixture }`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Contract §Function Signature]

- [ ] CHK009 Is the `mc:ready-for-owner` label definition precise about name, hex color without `#`, description, and mapping to `ready_for_owner`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Contract §GitHub Label]
